pairs.subject: health-checks
pairs.evidence: crates/core/src/resilience/invariants.rs:221 An invariant whose regex cannot compile disappears from the results instead of reporting unverifiable, allowing incomplete checking to appear clean.

techniques.evidence: crates/core/src/doctor.rs:29 Doctor scans are explicitly on demand; resilience observation consumes extraction runs rather than launching probes on render.

crates/core/src/resilience/detect.rs:621 The invariant score aggregates only returned checks: invalid regex checks disappear from coverage, and an empty set contributes zero without an undetermined annotation.
crates/server/src/routes/doctor.rs:122 Every doctor request gathers facts directly; the handler has no shared result cache or in-flight deduplication, so concurrent callers repeat full scans.

crates/server/src/routes/doctor.rs:189 The filesystem probe performs a full artifact walk and is awaited without a deadline or cancellation cleanup; the revision-count ceiling does not bound that walk.
crates/core/src/doctor.rs:227 Findings provide concrete instructions but lack the required structural per-check declaration of fixability or external action.
crates/core/src/resilience/invariants.rs:221 Regex compilation failure silently skips the invariant instead of returning an unverifiable outcome with the probe failure reason.
